Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Gascoyne, Goldfields, South Interior, South West, South Coastal, Great Southern, Central Wheat Belt
warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds, large hailstones and heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding over the next several hours in the Goldfields and parts of the Gascoyne, South Interior and Central Wheat Belt districts. Locations which may be affected include Kalgoorlie, Meekatharra, Norseman, Laverton, Leinster and Leonora.
